capabilities: Update created and updated timestamps in note properties after editing sessions
Count revisions per session, with counting optionally off
Preserve unrelated frontmatter and existing property blocks
Exclude folders from tracking and defer unrendered Templater expressions
Complete pending sessions on save, explicit save, or desktop quit
extras: Beta release installed manually by copying files into the plugins folder; the README warns to disable other automatic property writers and to test on disposable notes first, and links to a separate beta test guide.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically record when a note's content was last meaningfully edited or how many revision sessions it has had.

relations.evidence: unrendered Templater expressions in frontmatter are deferred automatically

summary: Tracks created and updated timestamps and optional revision counts in note properties after meaningful editing sessions.
